title: ViSAGe: A Global-Scale Analysis of Visual Stereotypes in Text-to-Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images for 135 nationality-based identity groups using text-to-image models and assessing the prevalence of visual stereotypes via human annotations and automated captioning (CLIP and BART). The study also measures 'stereotypical pull' by calculating the cosine similarity of CLIP image embeddings across default, stereotypical, and non-stereotypical prompts, and quantifies the offensiveness of the generated depictions.
